digest.component_or_area: rebar._store.sync — reconverge union merge abort recovery
propositions: A reconverge whose union merge aborts due to local changes to tracked store-artifact files (deletions or modifications) now completes by restoring tracked deletions from HEAD and quarantining worktree modifications before restoring, then retrying the merge once.
Tracked file deletions in the working tree (git status ' D' or staged 'D ') are restored non-destructively via git checkout without data loss, since content already exists at HEAD.
Tracked file modifications in the working tree (git status ' M') are byte-for-byte copied into the reconverge-quarantine directory before being restored, preserving local bytes.
Genuine merge conflicts (both sides committing different content) retain the original behavior: merge aborts, local is kept, and fsck-recover hint is provided.
The recovery mechanism reuses the parsing and retry pattern from variant (a) (untracked files) rather than introducing a separate abort-recovery pathway.
